text: Filmmaker Carl Denham sails from New York with struggling actress Ann Darrow toward [an uncharted island with a skull-shaped mountain|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. Behind a vast stone wall the islanders seize Ann and [offer her on an altar as the bride of Kong|wrong|human sacrifice], a giant ape who carries her into a jungle of living dinosaurs. Denham brings Kong back in chains to a Broadway stage, where [the photographers' flashbulbs|images|pictures, screens and recordings] set him loose to [reclaim Ann and climb the Empire State Building with her in his grasp|wants|a lover to possess].
